clauses.english: killed Abner to avenge his brother Asahel
clauses.ukr: убив Авнера за кров свого брата Асаїла
clauses.deu: tötete Abner um des Bluts seines Bruders Asahel willen
clauses.spa: mató a Abner a causa de la muerte de su hermano Asael

clauses.why: The verses say he thrust darts through Absalom's heart while he was alive in the oak; the killing was finished by his armourbearers, and 'hung' is not stated.
clauses.english: thrust three darts through the heart of Absalom while he was still alive in the oak
clauses.ukr: устромив три стріли в серце Авесалома, що ще живий був на середині дуба
clauses.deu: stieß drei Spieße Absalom ins Herz, als er noch an der Eiche lebte
clauses.spa: hincó tres dardos en el corazón de Absalom, que aún estaba vivo en medio del alcornoque

clauses.why: Joab struck Amasa with the sword in the hand, not 'while greeting'; the greeting detail is how it was done, so trim it.
clauses.english: killed Amasa with a sword in the fifth rib
clauses.ukr: убив Амасу мечем, ударивши його в живіт
clauses.deu: tötete Amasa, indem er ihn mit dem Schwert in den Bauch stach
clauses.spa: mató a Amasa hiriéndolo con la daga en la quinta costilla

clauses.why: Benaiah slew him by Solomon's command; the altar is given in 1KI 2:28-29, and the citation should include the fleeing; the clause's subject must remain Joab.
clauses.english: was slain by Benaiah on Solomon's order after he fled to the altar
clauses.ukr: був убитий Бенаєю за наказом Соломона після того, як утік до жертівника
clauses.deu: wurde auf Salomos Befehl von Benaja getötet, nachdem er zum Altar geflohen war
clauses.spa: fue muerto por Benaía por orden de Salomón después de huir al altar

answer.note: The line omits Joab's turning after Adonijah, and his holding back the people after Absalom's death.
